summary: Himalaya Shipping Ltd. filed a Form 6-K containing a commercial update and cash distribution announcement for April 2026. The company reported average TCE earnings of ~US$41,600/day (including scrubber benefits) for its fleet of twelve vessels, with eleven on index-linked charters and one on a fixed charter. The board approved a cash distribution of US$0.15 per share from Contributed Surplus. The filing is a routine operational and dividend update, with no acquisition, divestiture, tender offer, restructuring, or other special situation. No deal terms, advisor mentions, or structural changes are present. This is an ordinary current report, not a special-situation filing.
